o:t1996_d: Ɗalibai a École Centrale Paris sun fara VideoLAN don watsa bidiyo ta hanyar sadarwar harabar makarantar.

o:t2001_d: A ranar 1 ga Fabrairu, École ta amince da sakin komai a ƙarƙashin GNU GPL.
o:t2004_d: Aiki ya fara kan x264, wanda ya zama babban H.264 encoder na duniya.
o:t2008_d: Al'ummar ta haɗu a Paris don VideoLAN Dev Days na farko.
o:t2009_d: VideoLAN ta rabu da École kuma tana ƙarƙashin jagorancin ƙungiyarta mai zaman kanta.
o:t2011_d: An sake lasisi manhajar don kowace manhaja, kyauta ko a'a, ta iya haɗa ta.
o:t2012_d: Gangamin Kickstarter ya tara £47,056 don kawo VLC zuwa Windows 8, RT da Phone.
o:t2013_d: VLC na iOS ya dawo kan App Store, kyauta a kowace ƙasa.
o:t2016_d: VLC ya iso kan allon ɗakin zama.
o:t2017_d: VideoLAN ya shiga Alliance for Open Media don gina codec marar kuɗin sarauta.
o:t2018_d: Mai fassara AV1 ya fara tare da al'ummar FFmpeg, kuma ba da daɗewa ba ya shiga manyan manhajojin lilo.
o:t2021_d: Shekaru ashirin na manhaja kyauta da saukewa fiye da biliyan 3.5.
o:t2025_d: A taron CES, VideoLAN ya nuna ƙirƙira da fassara rubutun bidiyo kai tsaye a kan na'ura don VLC 4.0.
o:t2026_d: Taron Dev Days na 15 a Rome, VLC {v} mai gyare-gyaren tsaro 130+, da saukewa biliyan 7.

p:ffbbafe67023: Encoders masu alaƙa, da tsofaffin ayyuka da aka ajiye don dubawa.

t:about_h: Daga hanyar sadarwa ta harabar jami'a zuwa ga dukkan duniya.
t:about_p: VideoLAN aiki ne kuma ƙungiya ce mai zaman kanta a ƙarƙashin dokar Faransa, wacce masu aikin sa-kai ke gudanarwa waɗanda suka yi imani da ƙarfin buɗaɗɗen tushe.
t:and_1: Wayoyi, allunan kwamfuta, Chromebooks da Android TV
t:and_2: Laburaren fayilolin midiya, rabon hanyar sadarwa da samun damar shiga daga nesa
t:and_3: Kyauta a Google Play da F-Droid
t:c1_p: Fara da Jagoran Hacker sannan ka tura buƙatun haɗawa a GitLab.
t:c2_p: Kawo VLC da wannan rukunin yanar gizo zuwa yarenka.
t:c3_p: Amsa tambayoyi a dandalin tattaunawa da kuma a IRC.
t:c4_p: Gwada sigogin nightly builds kuma ku taimaka mana gyara kurakurai.
t:com_h: Mutane kamar ku ne suka yi VLC.
t:com_p: Masu haɓakawa daga ƙasashe sama da 40, masu fassara, masu gwaji da masu sa-kai da ke amsa tambayoyi a kowace rana.
t:d_card_month: Gudummawar kowane wata ta kati tana amfani da biyan kuɗi na Stripe; soke a kowane lokaci daga rasit ɗinka.
t:d_card_note: Za ka shigar da katin ka a shafin biya mai tsaro na Stripe. VideoLAN ba ta taɓa ganin lambar katin ka ba.
t:d_legal: VideoLAN ƙungiya ce mai zaman kanta a ƙarƙashin dokar Faransa ta 1901. Ba a raba kowane irin riba.
t:d_min: Da fatan za a zaɓi aƙalla {a}.
t:d_more_note: Ka fi son bayar da lokaci ko na'urori? Muna maraba da masu haɓakawa, masu fassara, marubuta, masu gwaji da masu zane.
t:d_opening: Ana buɗe shafin biya mai tsaro…
t:d_paypal_note: Ci gaba a PayPal. Ba a buƙatar asusun PayPal, babu ƙarancin adadi, ana iya biya kowane wata.
t:d_sepa_note: Don gudummawar Yuro daga asusun bankunan Turai. Za ka tabbatar da IBAN ɗinka a shafin biya mai tsaro na Stripe.
t:d_story: Babu tallace-tallace, babu bibiya, babu kamfani a bayanta. Masu sa-kai ne suka ƙirƙiri VLC kuma ƙaramar ƙungiya mai zaman kanta ce ke tafiyar da ita. Kowane gudummawa tana tafiya kai tsaye zuwa aikin.
t:d_title: Kiyaye VLC ta kasance kyauta. Ga kowa, har abada.
t:d_wallet_note: Apple Pay da Google Pay suna buɗewa a shafin biya mai tsaro na Stripe a kan na'urori masu goyan baya.

t:dl_verify_p: Kwatanta sawun SHA-256 da aka nuna a nan da wanda aka lissafa a na'urarku. Kowane fayil kuma an sa hannu da maɓallin GPG na VideoLAN a sabobin madubanmu.
t:dlm_p: Kowane tsarin aiki, kowane tsari: masu shigarwa, rumbuna, shagunan manhaja, kunshin shiri da lambar tushe.
t:don_h: Kiyaye VLC kyauta, ga kowa, har abada.
t:don_p: VLC ba shi da tallace-tallace kuma ba ya bin sawu — ba ya buƙatarsu. Gudummawarku tana biyan kuɗin sabobi, bandwidth, na'urorin gwaji da tarurrukan masu haɓakawa.

t:eco_bluray: Buɗaɗɗun ɗakunan karatu don diski da menu na DVD da Blu-ray.
t:eco_dav1d: Mai buɗe lambar AV1 da masu binciken intanet da tsarin aiki ke amfani da shi.
t:eco_dvblast: MPEG-2 TS demuxer da streamer mai sauƙi don masu watsa shirye-shirye.
t:eco_h: Tarin fasahar multimediya mai buɗaɗɗen tushe a bayan kwan ɗin.
t:eco_libvlc: Sanya injin VLC a cikin manhajarku, a kowane tsarin aiki.
t:eco_multicat: Kayan aiki don ɗauka da sarrafa kwararar multicast.
t:eco_x264: Madaidaicin mai haɗa lambar H.264, wanda ke bayan yawancin bidiyon yanar gizo.
t:f1_p: MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, FLAC, DVD, Blu-ray, kai tsaye… VLC yana zuwa da nasa codecs, don haka fayiloli suna buɗewa kai tsaye.
t:f2_h: Mai sauri, a kan kowace na'ura
t:f2_p: Yin amfani da GPU don buɗe lamba a kowane tsari, tare da zero-copy da zaɓin komawa manhaja. 4K, 8K, HDR10 da 10-bit.
t:f3_h: Fassarar rubutu, daidai a kan lokaci
t:f3_p: SRT, ASS, WebVTT, DVB da rubutun saurare. Matsar da su da maɓallan G da H har sai sun daidaita daidai.
t:f4_p: HLS, DASH, RTSP, SRT da multicast. Bincika NAS ɗinku ta SMB, NFS da UPnP, sannan ku tura zuwa Chromecast.
t:f5_p: Babu tallace-tallace, babu bin sawu, babu asusu. Abin da kuke kallo yana nan a na'urarku kawai.
t:f6_p: An fitar da shi ƙarƙashin GPL ta ƙungiya mai zaman kanta. Masu aikin sa-kai ne suka gina shi, tare da tallafin kuɗi daga mutane kamar ku.
t:f7_p: Kayan ado, ƙarin ayyuka, rubutun Lua da cikakken tsarin matatun sauti da bidiyo.
